from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metrics from a single company's Form 10-Q."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the filing")
    reporting_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The specific period covered by the report, e.g., 'Three Months Ended March 31, 2025'")
    
    # Cash Flow
    operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities value (signed)")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Scale unit of cash flow amount, e.g., 'million', 'thousand'")
    
    # Shares
    shares_outstanding: Optional[float] = Field(description="Weighted-average diluted shares outstanding value")
    shares_outstanding_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Scale unit of share count, e.g., 'million', 'thousand'")
    
    # Earnings
    diluted_eps: Optional[float] = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CompanyFinancials]
